newsitem.title: USA: D.R. Horton Q1 net sales contracts up.
newsitem.headline: D.R. Horton Q1 net sales contracts up.

text.p: D.R. Horton Inc said Thursday net sales contracts signed during the first quarter ended December 31, 1996 increased to $129.8 million from $115.4 million in the same period of 1995.

The company said in a release that net sales contracts increased 12 percent for the first quarter of fiscal 1997, with $129.8 million translating into 751 homes, compared with last year's $115.4 million totaling 699 homes.
The company said its backlog of homes under contract at December 31, 1996 was up 35 percent to $223.5 million, or 1,208 homes, compared with $165 million, or 968 homes, at December 31, 1995.

The increased results, along with recent acquisitions, "places the company in an excellent position for increased deliveries during the second fiscal quarter and the remainder of fiscal 1997," it said.
